speaker: Narrator
text: It was a crisp autumn morning. The scent of roasted coffee beans lingered in the air as Emma waited at the corner café.

speaker: Emma
text: I hope he remembers what I look like. It's been... what, five years?

speaker: Narrator
text: She glanced at her phone again. The minutes felt longer than usual.

speaker: Emma
text: Liam! Wow, it’s really you. You haven’t changed a bit!

speaker: Liam
text: I could say the same. You still check your phone when you’re nervous.

speaker: Narrator
text: They both laughed, and just like that, the years between them disappeared.

speaker: Emma
text: So… what’s new? Tell me everything.

speaker: Liam
text: Only if you promise to share your famous book list. I’ve missed our café conversations.

speaker: Narrator
text: And as the coffee steamed between them, two friends found something warmer — familiarity.
